items.title: ACF plugin bug gives hackers admin on 50,000 WordPress sites
items.description: A critical-severity vulnerability in the Advanced Custom Fields: Extended (ACF Extended) plugin for WordPress can be exploited remotely by unauthenticated attackers to obtain administrative permissions. [...]

items.title: 'CrashFix' Scam Crashes Browsers, Delivers Malware
items.description: The attack consists of a NexShield malicious browser extension, a social engineering technique to crash the browser, and a Python-based RAT.

items.title: Mass Spam Attacks Leverage Zendesk Instances
items.description: The CRM vendor advised ignoring or deleting suspicious emails and said the attacks were not tied to any breach or software vulnerability.
